title: AgentResource
description: A reusable agent scoped to the caller's project.

id.description: The ID of the reusable agent.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the agent was created.

updated_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the agent was last updated.

name.description: A human-readable name for the agent, or null if it is unnamed.

metadata.description: Custom string key-value pairs attached to the agent.

model.description: The requested model name used for inference.

reasoning.description: The resolved reasoning configuration, including the model default for an omitted effort.

text.description: The resolved configuration for text generated by the agent.

service_tier.description: The resolved service-tier policy used for model requests.

instructions.description: Custom instructions appended to the agent's default base instructions.

multi_agent.description: The resolved configuration for creating and coordinating subagents.

McpConnectionOriginResource.description: Where outbound MCP HTTP connections originate.

enabled.description: Whether subagent tools are enabled. Defaults to false.

max_concurrent_subagents.description: Maximum number of subagents that may run concurrently, or null when disabled. Defaults to 6 when enabled.

MultiAgentConfigResource.description: The resolved configuration for creating and coordinating subagents.

PersistedAgentToolResource.description: A credential-free tool available to a reusable agent.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `function`.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema object describing the function's arguments.

defer_loading.description: Whether the function is deferred and discovered through tool search.

PersistedAgentToolResourceFunction.description: A function defined by the application.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `mcp`.

server_label.description: A label used to identify the MCP server in tool calls.

credential_id.description: The vault credential selected for this MCP server, if any.

transport.description: The credential-free transport used to connect to the MCP server.

request_metadata.description: Metadata included with requests to this MCP server.

allowed_tools.description: The MCP tools the agent may call, or null when all server tools are allowed.

required.description: Whether this MCP server must initialize before the first turn.

connection_origin.description: Where outbound MCP HTTP connections originate.

PersistedAgentToolResourceMcp.description: Tools provided by a remote MCP server without stored credentials.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `programmatic_tool_calling`.

enabled.description: Whether tools can be called from model-generated code.

PersistedAgentToolResourceProgrammaticTo.description: Enables calling tools from model-generated code.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `tool_search`.

PersistedAgentToolResourceToolSearch.description: Discovers deferred function tools and loads them into the model context.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `web_search`.

mode.description: The source used for web search results.

context_size.description: The amount of search context made available to the model. Defaults to `medium`.

allowed_domains.description: Allowed search domains, or `null` when the search is unrestricted.

location.description: Approximate location used to localize search results, if provided.

PersistedMcpTransportResource.description: A credential-free transport used to connect to an MCP server.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `http`.

server_url.description: The URL of the MCP server.

headers.description: Non-secret HTTP headers sent to the MCP server.

PersistedMcpTransportResourceHttp.description: Connects to an MCP server over HTTP.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `stdio`.

command.description: The command used to start the MCP server.

args.description: Arguments passed to the MCP server command.

cwd.description: The working directory used to start the MCP server.

env_vars.description: Environment variable names inherited from the execution environment.

PersistedMcpTransportResourceStdio.description: Starts an MCP server as a local process.

ReasoningEffortResource.description: The amount of reasoning effort used by an agent.

effort.description: The requested reasoning effort, or `null` when the model selects its own default.

summary.description: The requested reasoning summary format, or `null` when summaries are disabled.

ReasoningResource.description: The reasoning configuration used by an agent.

x-enumDescriptions: Returns a concise reasoning summary when supported.
Returns a detailed reasoning summary when supported.
Automatically selects the most detailed summary supported by the model.
ReasoningSummaryResource.description: The reasoning summary format requested from an agent.

ServiceTierResource.description: The service-tier policy configured for an agent.

TextFormatResource.description: The effective output format for generated text.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `json_schema`.

schema.description: The JSON Schema that generated text must match.

TextFormatResourceJsonSchema.description: Constrains generated text to a JSON Schema.

type.description: The type of the object. Always `text`.

TextFormatResourceText.description: Generates ordinary text without a structured-output constraint.

format.description: The effective output format. Defaults to ordinary text.

verbosity.description: The amount of text produced by the agent. Defaults to `medium`.

TextResource.description: The text configuration used by an agent.

VerbosityResource.description: The amount of text produced by an agent.

WebSearchContextSizeResource.description: The amount of web search context made available to the model.

country.description: The two-letter ISO country code, such as `US`.

WebSearchLocationResource.description: Approximate user location used to localize web search results.

WebSearchModeResource.description: The source used for web search results.
